sepolia.note: Sepolia ENSv1 is marked no longer in use; the ENSv2 deployment is what Sepolia apps resolve through.

pinesignEth.pricedVia: the ENSv1 ETHRegistrarController at 0x59E1…E547, which is still the registration path
pinesignEth.note: The ENSv2 ETHRegistrar at 0xd6d8…cc81 reverts on available(string) and rentPrice(string,uint256): it has a different ABI, so do not assume the v1 controller's interface when scripting a real registration.

wildcardSubname.name: anything-random-12345.offchainexample.eth
wildcardSubname.meaning: An unregistered label under a gateway-backed parent resolves, so ENSIP-10 wildcard plus EIP-3668 CCIP-Read is working through the proxy.

forTheDesign: Resolve through the UpgradableUniversalResolverProxy at 0xeEeE…EeEe on both networks: it is the same address on mainnet and Sepolia and it follows offchain lookups, so one code path covers wildcard subnames without registering anything per user.
